t: This is St Nicholas Cole Abbey, a church on Queen Victoria Street, recorded here since the twelfth century. The Great Fire of London destroyed it in 1666, and the office of Sir Christopher Wren rebuilt it. Wren was given the task of rebuilding fifty-two City churches after the fire. In the Second World War, German bombs during the Blitz did substantial damage. Arthur Bailey reconstructed the church in 1961 and 1962. Whitley Heald, a Church of England clergyman who lived from 1694 to 1736, died here.
